fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) trades at P/E of 19.0x, lower than peer group members Hewlett Packard Enterprise (22.9x), IBM, Cisco Systems, and Apple, but recent trailing 4-quarter revenue growth of 49.0% exceeds Hewlett Packard Enterprise (26.6%).
fields.summary_ko.1: Infrastructure Solutions revenue as of July 31, 2026 surged 89% sequentially to $3.18B, with AI servers alone recording $1.64B, and unbooked AI orders reaching an all-time high of $9.5B.
